# Shuttle Brief
"Once an early atmospheric capable fishing ship it became obsolete with the discovery of space carp. Being a popular choice on the used market for cheap planetary exploration, The CBB corporation bought up almost all of the remaining stock and blueprints and now offers it as a medium sized luxury exploration ship."
